title: Bounds on the hitting probability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $r$ be a decidable binary relation on $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and form the directed graph whose edges are given by $r$. For every target vertex $t$, time $k$, and starting vertex $s$, the probability of hitting $t$ after $k$ steps is between $0$ and $1$, inclusive.
